Players Committee card image of [[Mustafar: Vader's Castle (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “'''Dark Side:''' Once per game, may deploy Vader here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your move phase, Vader may move between here and any battleground site.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/mustafarvaderscastle_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c 12d0bca] (12 December 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
